heard: A giant tennis court protects Webb from the sun. NASA had to fold this massive shield inside a rocket. It's made of five purple sheets thinner than human hair. Unfurling it required 400 pulleys and 90 cables. One snag could have killed the whole mission. It creates a wall with a 600 degree temperature gap. The sunny side cooks at 230 degrees Fahrenheit, but the telescope side stays at minus 390 degrees. A thin plastic shield is all that protects Webb from the sun.
